info.name: Anchorage Digital API Reference Addresses Vesting API
Get vesting balances for multiple allocations

items.docs: Get vesting balances for multiple allocation IDs in a single request. Returns per-allocation results with balance breakdowns including available, unvested, and locked amounts. Individual allocation errors are returned inline rather than failing the entire batch.

info.name: Get vesting balances for an allocation

params.name: allocationId
params.description: The ID of the allocation to get vesting balances for

params.name: stakeholderId
params.description: The external stakeholder ID (optional, used to retrieve wallet info when no transactions exist yet)

items.docs: Get vesting balances for a specific allocation ID. Returns the current balance breakdown including available, unvested, and locked amounts.

info.name: List offchain vesting schedules for an organization

params.name: afterId
params.description: When paginating this is used to provide the starting point for the page to fetch (retrieved from the previous response body)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per query

items.docs: Get all offchain vesting schedules for an organization.
